extracted.name: Creamy German Coleslaw
extracted.description: Six simple ingredients are all it takes to whip up German-inspired coleslaw. Serve at your next potluck or picnic.
ingredient_lines: 0.5 cup mayonnaise, or more to taste
instruction_lines: Place cabbage in a large bowl.
Mix sugar, vinegar, celery seed, and salt together in a separate bowl. Stir mayonnaise into sugar-vinegar mixture until dressing is smooth and creamy. Pour dressing over cabbage; toss to coat.
Marinate coleslaw in refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours; stir well before serving.
